paragraph.text: Crawllex — Platform & AI Agents: Internal Product Status
Crawllex is a multi-client SEO operations platform. Each client site is its own isolated project workspace. Four AI agents are planned on top of it.

Every Lens feature is either In progress or Planned. None is Done, because none is verified end to end. Lens is a separate service with its own repo. It reads Crawllex through a read-only connector.

Lens checks a client's website. It finds issues in the page content, the UI, the SEO setup, and the availability of the site. It reports the issues, tracks them over time, and checks whether fixes worked.
Lens rules: guidelines are not ranking rules. The checks follow published guidance and do not promise rankings.
Reads only the client's own site. Same-site only. DNS and target checks. Obeys robots.txt
Six viewports: 360, 390, 768, 1024, 1280, 1920 (owner to confirm, D2). Uses axe-core. Checks small text, tap targets, overflow, console errors, failed resources
About 28 rule IDs: titles, meta, headings, canonicals, image alt text, structured data, indexability, redirects
